Asset type: full-bleed cinematic scene for an intimate Chinese garden story, landscape 3:2.
Visual language: luminous, jewel-bright late-afternoon cinema, candid still from a sumptuous period film rather than a costume catalogue. Extremely tactile golden sunlight against deep clean petrol-blue woodland shadows. Warm sunlight STRIKES patches of cheeks, noses, fingers, loose hair and translucent ivory sleeves; the skin is NOT uniformly lit by a studio softbox. Preserve a sculptural transition from bright warm highlights into cool shadows; bold chiaroscuro, radiant rather than dim, neither muddy sepia nor flat HDR. Clear bright sunlit color, glowing translucent petals, creamy foreground flower bokeh, soft lens halation on the hottest highlights, crisp eyes, fine skin texture. Close 50mm cinematography, f/1.8, shallow depth, natural movement caught between poses. The light source is low and behind the women to camera-right. No oversized sunburst star, no fake beams crossing faces.
Wardrobe: airy layered historical-inspired hanfu with luminous IVORY ramie-and-silk gauze outer sleeves over coloured silk skirts and collars; delicate woven flower motifs, sunlight visibly transmits through folds. Loose fine hair, small flowers tucked near the ears. Avoid rough thick brown linen, heavy jackets, theatrical armour, modern accessories. Distinct recurring friends: A-tang with a soft round face, smiling eyes, a small coral flower at her half-up bun and coral-pink inner skirt; Qing-he with an oval face, gently arched brows, a jade ribbon in a loose low bun, celadon-green skirt; Wen-xi with a longer oval face, almond eyes, a blue ribbon in long half-up hair, sky-blue skirt and deep azure collar. All three are adult East Asian women in their twenties, fully dressed, joyful and unposed, each clearly different.

Scene: encounter flowers. The three friends pause in a wildly blooming meadow beside a low garden wall. Bright gold outlines individual hair strands and pale gauze, emerald leaves glow against blue distant hills. A lively brilliant spring afternoon, not an orange fog. Keep all three faces in frame and show the hands gathering flowers.
